component.name: bf-cbom
component.description: A comprehension-centric framework for analyzing Cryptography Bill of Material (CBOMs) generated by various tools. Compare CBOM outputs side-by-side, explore detected cryptographic assets, and orchestrate end-to-end benchmarks across containerized generators. In essence, your best friend for understanding the cryptographic posture of your software.
